styles.label: History
styles.blurb: The Mall monuments, the Smithsonian museums and Ford's Theatre.

styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Free museums, the Kennedy Center and neighbourhood markets.

styles.label: Family
styles.blurb: Air and Space, the Zoo and the National Archives, mostly free.

stays.why: Walk to the Mall, the White House and the big museums. Most central base for a first visit.
Quiet streets, the Capitol and Library of Congress on your doorstep; good Metro links.
Pretty historic streets, shops and waterfront dining. No Metro station, so plan on buses or walking.
Lively, central and good value; embassy mansions, cafés and a Metro stop.

food: Try a half-smoke sausage, the local speciality; chili-topped is the classic order.
Eastern Market on Capitol Hill is good for a cheap lunch and a weekend market browse.
Ethiopian food along 9th Street NW and in Adams Morgan is a local favourite; sharing platters feed two.
The Wharf and Georgetown waterfront have sit-down seafood; book ahead on weekends.
Food trucks near the Mall and office districts give filling lunches for around $10–15.
more_time: Swap a museum morning for Arlington National Cemetery and the Changing of the Guard, across the river by Metro.
Take a day trip to Old Town Alexandria: shops, the waterfront and historic streets, about 30–40 minutes by Metro or train.
Add a Potomac water taxi ride between Georgetown and the Wharf for a different view of the city.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the Mall monuments and the main free museums; add a night for Arlington and a day trip.

month_notes: Coldest month: highs near 6°C, lows around -2°C. Pack a warm coat and gloves.
Still cold, highs near 9°C. Indoor museums are the safe bet.
Warming up to about 13°C; cherry blossom timing varies, check on the day.
Pleasant spring: highs near 19°C, but expect about 11 rain days.
Great walking weather, highs around 24°C; carry a light rain jacket.
Warm and humid, highs near 29°C; go early and rest midday.
Hottest month, highs around 31°C with about 14 rain days. Plan indoor afternoons.
Hot and sticky, similar to July. Drink water and use shade on the Mall.
Warm and comfortable again, highs near 26°C; a good month to visit.
Crisp and clear, highs around 20°C; one of the best months.
Cooler, highs near 14°C; fewer rain days, about 8.
Cold again, highs around 9°C; pack layers and a warm hat.

climate_guide.summary: Four clear seasons: cold winters, warm humid summers, and the best weather in spring and autumn.

items.title: Best time: April, May, September, October
items.text: Highs of roughly 19–26°C and comfortable walking weather for the Mall and monuments.

items.title: Summer is hot and humid
items.text: July and August reach about 30–31°C with muggy air. Do outdoor sights in the morning.

items.title: Winter is genuinely cold
items.text: January highs near 6°C and lows around -2°C. Bring a proper coat, hat and gloves.

items.title: Rain is spread through the year
items.text: About 8–14 rain days a month, most in summer. A small umbrella is worth packing.

items.title: Long summer days
items.text: June and July give long daylight for evening monument walks; winter days are short.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Comfortable walking shoes, layers, a rain jacket, sunscreen in summer and a warm coat in winter.

transit.best: Walk the Mall and monuments; use Metrorail for everything further out.

modes.text: Metrorail is fast and clean; fares about $2-6 depending on distance and time.
Metrobus covers the city; fares are low and exact change or a card is needed.
Uber and Lyft work well; taxis are metered and easy to find downtown.
Driving is stressful: heavy rush-hour traffic, confusing parking rules and toll lanes.
Walking is the best way to see the Mall and monuments; bikeshare docks are everywhere.
No ferry service in the city centre; the Potomac water taxi links some waterfront spots.
